verdict.rationale: Temporal ships a Web UI and a CLI for monitoring and debugging Workflow executions, and keeps closed Workflow Histories (archivable for longer retention), which covers inspecting past execution logs. A hands-on user reports you can reset a workflow's execution state to before a given statement and re-run from there, which covers resuming from the failing step; automatic Activity retries and crash resumption add to this. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the reset/re-run-from-step operation (only community-sourced here), and documented UI/CLI flows for surfacing errors, which one user says are often buried in the event log.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step

citations.quote: Try Temporal Web UI by opening http://localhost:8233 for viewing your sample workflows executing on Temporal.
Use it to manage, monitor, and debug Temporal applications
Archival: Move closed Workflow Histories and Visibility records to blob storage for longer retention.
